name: IPD-KIR Database (killer-cell immunoglobulin-like receptor allele sequences)
maintainer: Anthony Nolan Research Institute (IPD team) with EMBL-EBI
scope: Named KIR alleles with genomic, nucleotide and protein sequences (kir.dat 35 MB, kir_gen.fasta, kir_nuc.fasta, kir_prot.fasta), allele lists, deleted alleles and alignments. The KIR region is highly polymorphic (GIAB README), so reference-based calls there need allele-aware handling.
mapping_methods: Allele names follow the KIR nomenclature; the allele list maps ids to names.

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivs: free to copy, distribute, display and make commercial use with credit by citing the maintainers; "strongly opposed to the mirroring of the data contained on our sites"; modified versions need permission (LICENCE.md, verified live).
licence.redistribution: Attribution required; mirroring is discouraged by the maintainers and modified versions need permission

update_frequency: Irregular releases (2.15.0 in December 2025; allele lists of every earlier release are kept).
coverage_limitations: Allele sequences and nomenclature only: no frequencies, associations or functional data
Gene-content haplotypes of the KIR region are not described here
known_omissions: Everything: the data are not mirrored here, following the maintainers' request

reuse_decision.rationale: Same terms and request as IPD-IMGT/HLA: no derivatives without permission and mirroring is discouraged. KIR allele sequences are used by reference; the GIAB KIR region and the RefSeq KIR gene models locate the region here.

status.notes: FTP listing, LICENCE.md and the allele list head were read; nothing larger was downloaded.

unverified_fields: number of alleles in the release (only the list head was read)

mechanism_evidence.note: named allele sequences for the KIR genes

evidence_profile.biological_context: Curated sequences of named KIR alleles from submitted samples; the genes are highly similar to each other and differ in presence between individuals.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Curated sequence records; completeness differs per allele.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Not applicable. It names and sequences alleles and asserts no functional or clinical effect.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: None: sequences carry no phenotype information.
evidence_profile.absence_means: An allele that is not listed has not been submitted and named. Absence of a KIR gene in a person is a real polymorphism and not a gap in the database.
